senses.en_definition: A certain; one unspecified thing, time, or situation.

messages.en: That photo of Sabah you sent is gorgeous. Let's go there together someday, shall we?
Let's do it! I've wanted to go for ages. But we'll need to save up first.
That's right. Let's start putting a little aside this month. Once we've saved enough, we can pick a date.
My intentions are good. I just want to help.
I know. You've already helped them a lot.

senses.en_definition: Already; indicating that something has happened or a state has been reached.

collocations.en: it has been a long time

senses.en_definition: Finished; completed or brought to an end.
Such is the case; emphasizing an established situation or an unchangeable fact.
Enough; used to tell someone to stop or let something go.

messages.en: I already paid earlier. You've got the receipt, right?
Yes, I've got it. I'll send you a photo of the receipt later so you can claim the money back easily.
Let it go. Don't dwell on it anymore. Let's get something to eat first.
Okay, I just want to clear my head. Let's eat at our usual place, yeah?
